detail.overview: Intex 86" Ultra HD 4K Interactive Flat Panel Display The IFPSL-8601/IFPSL-8602/IFPSL-8606/IFPSL-8607 86" Interactive Flat Panel is designed to elevate collaboration and learning experiences. Featuring a stunning 4K UHD display with an IPS panel and DLED backlight, it offers vibrant, clear visuals with 500 cd/m² brightness and a 1200:1 contrast ratio. The ultra-fine infrared 20-point multi-touch functionality allows for smooth interaction, making it ideal for classrooms, boardrooms, and conference spaces. Equipped with a 48 MP AI camera and 8 microphone array, this panel ensures crisp audio and video communication. Connectivity options include HDMI, USB Type-C, and LAN, with an optional OPS slot for additional functionality. Smart Learning Brochure
